title: putio-sync resources
description: CPU, memory, threads, open files and disk use of putio-sync, next to what it was doing. Source: packaging/grafana/putio-sync-resources.json in putio-sync.

list.name: Version changes
list.expr: max by (instance, host, version, commit) (putio_sync_build_info{app="putio-sync",host=~"$host"}) unless max by (instance, host, version, commit) (max_over_time(putio_sync_build_info{app="putio-sync",host=~"$host"}[1d] offset 10m)) or on(instance) max by (instance, host, version, commit) (putio_sync:build_info:max5m{app="putio-sync",host=~"$host"}) unless max by (instance, host, version, commit) (max_over_time(putio_sync:build_info:max5m{app="putio-sync",host=~"$host"}[1d] offset 10m))

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU time per second; 1 = one core busy.

panels.title: Open files
panels.description: Open file descriptors and the soft limit. The limit is absent when unlimited.

panels.title: Open files of limit
panels.description: Open files as a share of the soft limit. Empty when the limit is unlimited.

panels.title: CPU (avg and peak)
panels.description: CPU time per second; 1 = one core busy. Raw data inside the main Prometheus retention (30 days); older points come from the 5-minute thinned copy.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: In use is resident memory (RSS); reserved is virtual size. Raw data inside the main Prometheus retention (30 days); older points come from the 5-minute thinned copy.

panels.title: Threads
panels.description: OS threads. Raw data inside the main Prometheus retention (30 days); older points come from the 5-minute thinned copy.

panels.title: Open files vs limit
panels.description: Open file descriptors against the soft limit. Raw data inside the main Prometheus retention (30 days); older points come from the 5-minute thinned copy.

panels.title: Disk read and write
panels.description: Bytes per second the process read from and wrote to storage. Raw data inside the main Prometheus retention (30 days); older points come from the 5-minute thinned copy.

panels.title: Activity
panels.description: What putio-sync was doing, on the same time axis as the panels above. Syncing is 1 while a sync run is in progress (a share of the time on thinned points). Raw data inside the main Prometheus retention (30 days); older points come from the 5-minute thinned copy.

panels.title: Use by activity
panels.description: Time in each state over the dashboard range, with CPU and memory while in it. Always read from the 5-minute thinned copy, so it means the same thing at every range. Downloading N means N downloads at once on average over the 5 minutes; rows show only states that occurred.

panels.title: Per MB/s of download speed
panels.description: Average CPU and memory per MB/s of download speed, over 5-minute points while downloading. Points with no bytes downloaded are skipped. Read from the thinned copy.
